method: expected drop = reference threshold x (city summer irradiation / reference summer irradiation); threshold = expected drop rounded toward zero to a whole degree. Summer irradiation is recovered from the climate comparison's solar_only cooling benefit.
caveat: Rough derivation: the threshold scales only with summer irradiation and ignores ambient temperature, wind, cloud timing and roof build-up. A real programme must calibrate it with local before/after measurements on coated roofs.
